# Reviewer task

Audit the complete sample primer in `primer.md` for technical accuracy, explanatory depth and structure, citation support, and agreement with the supplied rendered contents in `rendered-contents.txt`. All material supplied for this exercise is local; the cited reference extracts in `reference.md` represent the complete relevant source. Report actionable findings with precise locations and explain reader impact. Distinguish definite errors from editorial judgements and avoid treating every short section as a defect. Do not modify the files.
